## Suggestions
- app/config.py:13 — tests — With `{"theme":"dark"}` already stored and `merge(path, {"theme": "dark"}, adopt=True)`, no test checks the resulting change list or file bytes. The adoption test changes `"light"` to `"dark"`; the existing equal-value test exercises only replacement. Add an equal-value adoption test that asserts the intended return value and file contents. — Changes to whether identical-value adoption records a change and rewrites the file could pass the current tests unnoticed.

- The existing replacement test checks byte preservation when the value is unchanged.
